hooks.text: 每次死亡都带着旧轮回知识改走新路线，逐步改写波斯覆灭命运
hooks.excerpt: Try your best to right your wrongs: each failure is a new chance to explore different paths, discover secrets, meet new characters, and use the knowledge gained from past attempts to change your people's fate and prove yourself as the true Prince of Persia.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 把闪避陷阱、跑墙与空中特技连成高速战斗动作链
hooks.excerpt: As the Prince of Persia, agility is your greatest weapon. Dodge traps, wall-run, chain acrobatic combos, and strike with precision. Every movement is an opportunity, and every battle will reward skill and style.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从100多种武器与徽章中解锁组合，每局重塑专属战斗流派
hooks.excerpt: Discover, unlock, and master over 100 unique weapons and medallions. Adapt, upgrade, and customize your build with each run, crafting deadly combinations that fit your playstyle.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
